episode.episode: 7-15-26 - Hour 4 - If BYU defeats Notre Dame and Utah will they go 12-0 this season?
episode.showDescription: Cougar Sports with Ben Criddle (@criddlebenjamin) keeps you up-to-date on all things BYU Sports. We not only cover football & basketball, but we dive into recruiting, baseball, soccer, and more. For insight that you can't get anywhere else, tune into 103.9/ 98.3 FM. Monday-Friday from 2-6 PM MST. Follow us on social media @espnthefan & interact with us using #ESPNTheFan.
episode.episodeDescription: Ben Criddle talks BYU sports every weekday from 2 to 6 pm. transcript_window.text: No way.
I was a sink or slider guy.
I just wanted you to hit the ball, and hopefully it was at one of the eight guys standing behind me.
Hey, man, that's not a bad way to do it.
You get enough.
It just has to be slightly off.
That's right.
Line drives right at the left fielder.
It's still an 0 for 1.
Still 0 for 1, no doubt about it.
Well, you got a World Championship Series ring with the New York Yankees.
Do you keep track of that still?
Do you keep track of tabs on the Yankees organization?
Very little.
I don't pay much attention until September.
I grew up in Cleveland, so I'm a big fan of Cleveland.
I've got a couple buddies that are still managing teams in the major leagues.
But you know what?
I've got a full -time job.
I'd rather go to a TCU beach volleyball game than to watch a major league baseball game at this point.
Sometimes you only have bandwidth enough for the competitive bandwidth and where your feet are at.
Mike, buddy, we salute you.
We appreciate you.
Thanks for taking some time out of your day to navigate the current state of the program at TCU, the Big 12, and the headwinds, as well as the opportunities that we're facing in college athletics.
Well, I always enjoy spending time with you.
Thanks for what you do covering this league, and good luck to BYU this season.
